author: ElementalAssasin
body:
We are always in search for new players. It doesn't matter where you come from or whatever age you are. you must be active for US/EU timezones as we are a US and EU team with the inclusion of some other players from different continents.


Application Format:
Do You have Ts and Discord?
Timezone:
Can you talk on ts?
Primary Position:
Secondary Position:
Can you call out?
Experience (OCN and Avicus):
Sword or Bow?Why?
Will you be willing to defend?
Bridging?
Skype?

We will take a look at every application and will respond in 1-2 days so please wait patiently for a response. If you haven't got a response on your application either contact me or one of the leaders.
